- From (2,6) going (1,−1): hits bottom cushion at (8,0).
- Reflects to (1,1): hits right cushion at (10,2).
- Reflects to (−1,1): hits top cushion at (6,6).
- Reflects to (−1,−1): travels straight to (0,0) — the corner pocket D.

Checking with the unfolding method: the straight line in the unfolded plane from (2,6) with direction (1,−1) first meets a lattice corner image at (20,−12), which folds back to (0,0), confirming the ball ends in pocket D.
